messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "do not exceed 37.5 mg a day for infants and children under 2 years"
set: ["do not exceed 37.5 mg a day for infants and children under 2 years", "do not exceed 100 mg a day for children 2 to 12 years", "do not use fluticasone furoate nasal spray for children under 2 years", "do not use fluticasone propionate nasal spray for children under 4 years", "do not exceed recommended dose", "do not exceed the maximum single dose of 150 mg for immediate-release tablets", "dose increases should not exceed 100 mg per day in a 3-day period", "8 mg oral dose administered twice a day for patients 12 years and older", "8 mg taken orally 2 times a day", "oral suspension in children 2 years and older: 0.125 mg/kg orally once a day (to a maximum dose of 7.5 mg/day)", "carefully observe infants for limpness", "use only once a day and do not use more than directed", "do not take a missed dose during the day", "do not reuse a needle", "carefully observe infants for breathing difficulties", "carefully observe infants for increased sleepiness"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
